'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Thomas Whaley DS Death Star: Conference Room''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Conference Room|ANH-D-deathstarconferenceroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' ICM
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
